summary.text: Eileen Kelly is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack 8 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a member of the House Finance Committee with more than 22 years on staff at the New Hampshire Legislature.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Eileen Kelly said she worked more than 22 years on staff at the New Hampshire Legislature, including as chief of staff to the Speaker of the House and as a senior legislative policy assistant.
She said she holds a B.A. in English, summa cum laude, from New England College and has lived in Bradford, New Hampshire, for 42 years.

Kelly said she chairs the Bradford Democrats, previously served on the board of New Hampshire Hunger Solutions, and was board chair of the New Hampshire Coalition Against Domestic and Sexual Violence.
Kelly took office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
In the survey she listed her key messages as reducing high property taxes, stopping the state's downshifting of costs to local towns, and addressing the state's housing crisis.
